name: Awake
description: Keep your Mac awake for a while, until you turn it off, or by itself when you choose.
whatsNew: Explains itself on its page in Settings.

howTo.goal: Keeps your Mac from going to sleep: for a while, until you turn it off, or by itself while the apps or conditions you choose are active.
rules: Pick how long from the panel; the menu bar icon turns your accent colour while it's on.
Rules below let it switch on by itself.
